title: Paluck Technologies IPO Details
intro:
Paluck Technologies IPO is a book build issue of ₹33.00 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 68.76 lakh shares of ₹33.00 crore.

Paluck Technologies IPO bidding opened for subscription on Aug 28, 2026 and will close on Sep 1, 2026. The allotment for the Paluck Technologies IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 2, 2026. Paluck Technologies IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 4, 2026.

Paluck Technologies IPO is set issue price band at ₹46 to ₹48 per share. The lot size for an application is 3,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,88,000 (6,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (9,000 shares), amounting to ₹4,32,000.

Horizon Management Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Giriraj Stock Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Paluck Technologies IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in April 2010, Paluck Technologies Limited is a diversified engineering services and infrastructure support company with operations across Automobile & Engineering Services, Construction Equipment Rental, Logistics & Fleet Management, and Telecom Engineering Services. The Company was originally founded in 2009 as a proprietorship firm providing diesel generator services and has since expanded into multiple infrastructure and engineering segments.

In the Construction Equipment Rental and Logistics segment, the Company provides concrete transportation, infrastructure equipment rental and RMC plant setup services. It operates a substantial fleet of over 190 specialized vehicles, including transit mixers, logistics trucks and concrete pump units, serving infrastructure developers, EPC contractors and cement manufacturers across key regions including Delhi NCR, Rajasthan, Haryana, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Odisha and Jammu & Kashmir. Its fleet is supported by an integrated digital monitoring system connected with ERP, SAP and GPS tracking solutions.

The Company also provides Telecom Engineering Services, acting as an implementation and maintenance partner for leading telecom operators and OEMs. It has managed operations and maintenance across 7,500+ telecom sites across India, supporting network expansion, upgrades and maintenance. In addition, Paluck Technologies operates as an Authorized Service Center and Dealership for various OEMs, providing diesel and gas generator servicing, dual-fuel conversion kits, RECD solutions, commercial vehicle and two-wheeler servicing, and spare parts distribution.
As of February 28, 2026, the Company had 192 employees across technology, operations, finance, sales, marketing and HR functions.
strengths: Deep expertise in NGT-compliant environmental solutions and DG sets.
Strong track record in managing 7,500+ telecom sites.
One of the largest construction equipment rental fleets in North India.
Long-standing relationships with leading telecom operators and OEMs.
Custom-built IT systems for real-time monitoring and business review.
Experienced management team with 10+ years of continuity
Diversified presence across engineering, logistics, telecom and infrastructure services.

faqs.question: How to apply in Paluck Technologies IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Paluck Technologies IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Paluck Technologies IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Paluck Technologies IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Paluck Technologies IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Paluck Technologies IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Paluck Technologies IPO opens on Fri, Aug 28, 2026 and closes on Tue, Sep 1, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Paluck Technologies IPO?
faqs.answer: Paluck Technologies IPO lot size is 3000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,88,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Paluck Technologies IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Paluck Technologies IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Paluck Technologies IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Paluck Technologies IPO will be done on Wednesday, September 2, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Sep 3, 2026 . Check the Paluck Technologies IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Paluck Technologies IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Sep 4, 2026 .
